name: Clopenthixol
aliases: Chlorpenthixol, zuclopenthixol, Zuclopenthixol, cis-Clopenthixol, cis(Z)-cloflupentixol, Cisordinol®, Clopixol®, NSC 64087
summary: Clopenthixol (Sordinol), also known as clopentixol, is a typical antipsychotic drug of the thioxanthene class. It was introduced by Lundbeck in 1961.

uses.text: Zuclopenthixol, the pure cis isomer, was later introduced by Lundbeck in 1962, and has been much more widely used. Clopenthixol is not approved for use in the United States.

pharmacology.en: It mainly blocks dopamine D1 and D2 receptors in the brain, which reduces psychotic symptoms. It also blocks some serotonin, histamine and adrenaline receptors, which adds to its side effects.
pharmacology.zh: 它主要阻斷大腦中的多巴胺 D1 與 D2 受體，藉此減輕精神病症狀。它也會阻斷部分血清素、組織胺與腎上腺素受體，這會增加副作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它主要阻断大脑中的多巴胺 D1 与 D2 受体，借此减轻精神病症状。它也会阻断部分血清素、组织胺与肾上腺素受体，这会增加副作用。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, stiffness, tremor and restlessness. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, a movement disorder that may be permanent, and rarely it causes neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、口乾、僵硬、顫抖與坐立不安。長期使用可能造成可能永久的遲發性運動障礙，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、口干、僵硬、颤抖与坐立不安。长期使用可能造成可能永久的迟发性运动障碍，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: Clopenthixol is a mix of two geometric forms, cis and trans. Nearly all of its antipsychotic effect comes from the cis form, which was later sold on its own as zuclopenthixol.
fact.zh: 氯哌噻噸是順式與反式兩種幾何異構物的混合物。它幾乎所有的抗精神病作用都來自順式，後來順式被單獨製成珠氯噻醇（zuclopenthixol）販售。
fact.zhHans: 氯哌噻吨是顺式与反式两种几何异构物的混合物。它几乎所有的抗精神病作用都来自顺式，后来顺式被单独制成珠氯噻醇（zuclopenthixol）贩售。
